provenance.graph_diagonal_proof: With all scalar Casimir graph currents assigned (d,d-1), the HL diagonal sets these currents and positive jets to zero. The potential lies in the square of the basic invariant ideal, so its slice derivatives vanish modulo the restricted invariants. The diagonal ring is therefore the nilcone intersected with the Slodowy slice. Flatness of the restricted adjoint quotient gives the regular sequence of basic Casimirs.
provenance.invariant_square_reason: The potential has degree p+1 > 6, the largest basic SO8 Casimir degree; every monomial therefore has at least two invariant factors.
provenance.method: Adjoint sl2 branching and the nilcone-slice complete intersection; two exact expansion algorithms
provenance.scope: Exact HL diagonal for the scalar Casimir graph presentation. Does not compute full Macdonald, establish physical filtration uniqueness, locate a jump or extend Schur validation.
provenance.variable_convention: z^2 = t = qT; degrees in the rational function are z degrees

jump_verification.method: Generic field arc equality through q10 and a rational q11 witness below the fixed series. This certificate belongs only to its specified Higgsing.

elimination.scope: Over the generic parameter field the quadratic Hessian is invertible. Completing the square eliminates both variables and all their jets; the remaining Jacobian is that of the substituted potential. The discarded denominator is a nonzero field scalar.

proof.scope: Exact QQ filtered graph through q12. Generic rational-function-field arc equality through q10, followed by a rational q11 rank-drop witness, proves the earliest jump is q11. The witness certifies a lower bound, not the exact generic rank-drop size.

verification_plan.rationale: First slice Macdonald investigation. Select jump+1, retaining the existing q12 Schur window. The fixed q12 QQ GB took 0.26 s; generic q10 earliestness needed quadratic elimination after two 1-GiB failures and then about 107 s. No previous +2 plan exists for this Higgsed case; q13 remains an uncomputed optional extension.
